description: Scout: ETF news for one day from ETFIQ's ETF News, read from SEC filings: launches (funds that began trading), closures and closing notices, funds filed and not yet trading, name or ticker changes, fee changes and splits. Defaults to the latest day published (is_latest and lag_days say how old that is); pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for an earlier trading day, kind to see one kind, ticker for one fund. Each event is one dated sentence with its SEC form, filing date and link. Closures and launches come first. limit 1 to 100, default 25; matching is the whole count.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest published day.

name: etf_news_today
